definition: A fine plaster or cement finish, textured or smoothed and applied to walls and ceilings, especially on the exterior of buildings.
origin: From Italian stucco, itself borrowed from Old High German stukki (a crust, a piece, a fragment). English adopted the term directly in the 17th century along with the Italian technique itself.
